description: Correct a logged timeslip — change the hours, the date, the task it sits under, or its comment. Only the fields you pass are changed. FreeAgent refuses once the time has been billed on an invoice.

comment.description: What the time was spent on

datedOn.description: Date the work was done YYYY-MM-DD

hours.description: Corrected hours as a decimal string (e.g. '7.5' for 7h30m)

task.description: Move the time to a different task on the same project

name: freeagent_update_timeslip
